text:
sarah (support): forwarding a customer's report — they say function/tool calling behavior changed right after last rollout. customer says tools either aren't called or get wrong args. pasted below what they sent.

anita (customer-success): customer=acme-inc, org 7442, using hosted API, high usage, on paid plan. they're pretty upset, escalated to P1.

sarah (support): exact customer repro they provided:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant that calls tools when needed."},{"role":"user","content":"Charge the invoice for order 12345 for $100.00 to the card on file."}],"functions":[{"name":"create_invoice","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"order_id":{"type":"string"},"amount_cents":{"type":"integer"}}}}],"function_call":"auto"}'
```
Expected: a function call to `create_invoice` with `order_id":"12345"` and `amount_cents":10000`.
Actual response (customer copy):
```json
{"id":"resp_abc","object":"chat.completion","choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"Done. Invoice created for $100.00."},"finish_reason":"stop"}],"usage":{"total_tokens":312}}
```
No `function_call` object returned. in another example they got a function call but with wrong arg types: `amount_cents":"100usd"` (string) instead of integer.

tom (eng-ml): thanks — can you confirm which exact model variant was routed? redwood-v2 could have variants (opt, q8). also need the request trace id from the customer's headers (x-rw-trace or request-id). is this consistently reproducible for them or intermittent?

deploy-bot: rollout complete for redwood-v2 at 2024-07-20T21:00:12Z (sha: a3f7c9d) — canary->prod.

lee (eng-runtime): we're seeing a spike in sequences that hit the alternate parser path after that deploy. possible change in function-call detection when tokens near boundary get truncated. need the raw tokenized sequence & request headers.

sarah (support): i asked customer for `x-rw-trace` (they gave: trace=tr_0a9f2b) and pasted a second failing request below with headers and response: 
```http
POST /v1/chat/completions HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer **REDACTED**
X-RW-TRACE: tr_0a9f2b
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "model":"redwood-v2",
  "messages":[{"role":"system","content":"Assistant must call tools for billing ops."},{"role":"user","content":"Please make a payment of $250 for invoice INV-9921."}],
  "functions":[{"name":"create_invoice","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"invoice_id":{"type":"string"},"amount_cents":{"type":"integer"}}}}],
  "function_call":"auto"
}

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{
  "id": "resp_xyz",
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "choices": [{"message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "Payment scheduled for $250."}, "finish_reason": "stop"}],
  "usage": {"total_tokens": 298}
}
```
no `name`/`arguments` found.

tom (eng-ml): two likely vectors: 1) model changed behavior (generation steering less likely to emit `function_call` token sequence) 2) runtime parser/heuristics changed and stopped converting a raw generation into the structured `function_call` object. can we reproduce by sending the same prompt to the canary and to the old variant? lee, can you run a cross-check between the pre-rollout sha and a3f7c9d?

lee (eng-runtime): running now. quick dump of relevant runtime log lines for trace tr_0a9f2b: 
```
[2024-07-21T21:03:02Z] trace=tr_0a9f2b model=redwood-v2 sha=a3f7c9d runtime=prod-01 parser_path=alt_parser seq_len=278 tokens=...
[2024-07-21T21:03:02Z] trace=tr_0a9f2b assistant_output="Payment scheduled for $250." finish_reason=stop function_call_detected=false
[2024-07-21T21:03:02Z] trace=tr_0a9f2b fallback_to_text=true
```
in contrast, same prompt against sha=b7d4f2a (pre-rollout) yields: 
```
[2024-07-21T20:58:10Z] trace=tr_0a9f2b model=redwood-v2 sha=b7d4f2a runtime=canary parser_path=main_parser assistant_output="{\"name\":\"create_invoice\",\"arguments\":{\"invoice_id\":\"INV-9921\",\"amount_cents\":25000}}" function_call_detected=true
```
so the model generation at pre-rollout included the structured tokens; post-rollout it returned natural language and parser didn't detect.

ops-bot: created incident INC-2024-0423 (P1) — "function-calling regressions after redwood-v2 rollout".

anita (customer-success): recommended mitigation to customer: pin model to sha=b7d4f2a or route their org to the previous variant while we investigate. sarah, can you confirm you've applied the routing override?

sarah (support): applied routing override for org 7442 -> redwood-v2@b7d4f2a now. customer notified — they're testing. they said initial tests are green when pinned.

tom (eng-ml): next steps: 1) diff the model tokenizer and system/prompt templates between shas — check for subtle tokenization changes (esp around punctuation and braces). 2) add regression unit for function_call emission and ensure our postprocessing parser tolerates minor format variance (e.g., unquoted numbers, trailing periods). 3) add canary metric for function_call presence rate by route.

lee (eng-runtime): immediate runtime mitigation: we'll add a heuristic postprocessor that attempts to extract JSON blob from assistant text and call it a function_call if valid JSON is present. pushing a hotfix to prod canary now. if that works we'll roll it to the fleet.

tom (eng-ml): please capture 3 failing traces (include request payloads) — I need them to run model scoring locally. sarah — can you forward tr_0a9f2b plus two more?

sarah (support): got two more traces from the customer (tr_0b7d33, tr_0c9e11) forwarded to the eng channel and attached to INC-2024-0423. customer is on standby; they appreciate the routing override.

anita (customer-success): marking customer as "escalated — under active mitigation" and scheduling a check-in in 30 minutes.

tom (eng-ml): longer-term: add regression tests to our CI that run common function schemas + prompts across model variants. also coordinate with model providers if this corresponds to a new model artifact.

sarah (support): closing loop with customer for now — will re-open if they see issues after hotfix. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
